run_numer_sense_preprocessing: run the NumerSense module to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_numer_sense_dataset: create a NumerSense dataset instance that loads the HuggingFace numer_sense dataset
build_train_test_split: build an 80/20 train/test split from the numer_sense dataset using get_train_test_lines
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of sentence-target tuples with mask token replacement
load_numer_sense_dataset: load the numer_sense dataset from HuggingFace using the load_dataset method
